forwarding.title: SMS and call forwarding
forwarding.description:
Forward received messages and incoming-call notifications to selected saved recipients. The integration always removes the source number from the target list, so it never sends a copy back to the sender. Messages recognized as commands are not forwarded by default.

Template variables:

- `{data_czas}` — date and time the message or call was received in the Home Assistant local time zone
- `{nadawca}` — SMS sender or incoming caller phone number
- `{nazwa_nadawcy}` — saved sender name, or their phone number
- `{wiadomosc}` — original received SMS text
- `{dzwoniacy}` — incoming caller phone number
- `{typ}` — event type: `SMS` or `POŁĄCZENIE`

data.forward_calls_enabled: Send an SMS notification for incoming calls
data.forward_command_messages: Also forward SMS messages recognized as commands
data.forward_excluded_recipient_ids: Do not forward messages or calls from these saved senders

sms_commands.title: SMS commands and replies

add_sms_rule.title: Add SMS rule
add_sms_rule.description:
Polish characters, letter case, and repeated whitespace are ignored. `{value}` captures a parameter: `set lounge {value}` accepts `set lounge 22`. With a PIN, send `<command> <PIN>`, for example `set lounge 22 1234`. For a challenge, reply exactly `POTWIERDZ 123456` using the one-time code. PINs are never stored in plaintext; an empty PIN on edit preserves the current hash. A selected script is the safe container for a custom sequence.

Reply variables:
`{data_czas}` – date and time when the reply is sent.
`{zmienna}` – raw entity state.
`{stan}` – localized entity state.
`{jednostka}` – entity state unit.
`{nazwa_encji}` – friendly entity name.
`{entity_id}` – entity identifier.
`{nadawca}` – saved sender name or masked phone number.
`{komenda}` – received command text.
`{value}` – parameter captured from the command.
`{wynik}` – combined state description for all selected entities.
`{liczba_encji}` – number of handled entities.

edit_sms_rule.title: Edit SMS rule
edit_sms_rule.description:
Change the sender, command, targets, action, conditions and protection. PIN format: `<command> <PIN>`. Challenge format: `POTWIERDZ <code>`. Leaving PIN empty preserves the current hash. `{value}` captures a parameter.

Reply variables:
`{data_czas}` – date and time when the reply is sent.
`{zmienna}` – raw entity state.
`{stan}` – localized entity state.
`{jednostka}` – entity state unit.
`{nazwa_encji}` – friendly entity name.
`{entity_id}` – entity identifier.
`{nadawca}` – saved sender name or masked phone number.
`{komenda}` – received command text.
`{value}` – parameter captured from the command.
`{wynik}` – combined state description for all selected entities.
`{liczba_encji}` – number of handled entities.

restart_required.title: Restart Home Assistant to finish updating Q-Tronic SMS Gateway
restart_required.description:
The Q-Tronic SMS Gateway add-on synchronized a new custom integration version (`{synced_version}`) into `/config/custom_components`, but Home Assistant is still running version `{current_version}`. Restart Home Assistant Core to load the updated integration and restore actions like `qtronic_sms_gateway.send_sms` / `qtronic_sms_gateway.call_to`.

Previous synced version: `{previous_version}`.
